iWantTo: see batch_number and serial_number as distinct labeled fields in the stock UI (stock table and SKU detail view) in place of the combined inventory_code
soThat: each tracking dimension is individually readable without parsing a hyphen-delimited string

independence.rationale: S2 completes the schema migration entirely at the DB layer; S3 is a UI/API surface change — the stock table and SKU detail view still render inventory_code until S3 ships, so the user-facing split-field display is genuinely unbuilt after S2
